title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Dhaka-Northwest Corridor Road Project, Phase 2 - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The project will improve the road connectivity and efficiency of Dhaka-Northwest international trade corridor. To ensure the sustainability of the outcome, an associated technical assistance is proposed to assist the government in updating its master plan for roads and improving its planning capacity.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3592: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 14 May 2025
Loan 3593: 86% of contracts awarded and 85% disbursed as of 14 May 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: The Achieved Progress of SASEC-2 (awarded contracts) up to March 2023 was 63%.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40540/40540-017-apfs-en_4.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jun 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40540/40540-017-rp-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40540/40540-017-smr-en_15.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: - The TA consultant has been engaged under the associated TRTA since September 2019. Progress of the consulting services has been delayed due to COVID-19 outbreak in Bangladesh. TA will be closed on 31 Dec 2023.
Procurement for construction of road research and training center under WP-14 has been awarded on 9 Sep 2021 and road operation unit for road safety maintenance, etc. under WP-15 has been awarded on 7 April 2022 under Loan 3883, tranche-2.
Completed.
Seven contracts (WP-06 to WP-12) have been awarded and contractors have already mobilized. As of 30 September 2023, the Physical progress of these seven packages is : 79.56%,58.02%,72.77%,90.05%,95.10%.
The Achieved Progress of SASEC-2 (awarded contracts) up to September 2023 was 71.02%. This delayed progress has been occurred due to less intension of the Contractors, small scaled construction, less procurement of the materials, LA issues, delayed shifting of U/G Utilities, un-demolished obstacles and COVID-19 etc.
Detailed Design included the safety elements. Will be achieved by the end of the project.
At present, Improvements are ongoing for 176.8 KM of existing road under seven work packages.
